figure_alt: Horizontal dot plot of answer changes by days between repeat answers about the same signifier, with 95% confidence intervals. Rates rose from 6.4% at 1–7 days to 8.8% at 181+ days, with similar rates at 31–90 and 91–180 days.
prompt: Among repeated respondent–signifier observations, does a longer interval between sessions correspond to a greater chance of changing an answer?
title: Answers changed more often after longer gaps
